title: A search box that stops firing a request per keystroke

concepts.description: Waiting until input has been quiet for a short interval before acting, so a burst of events causes one call instead of many.
concepts.context: the 250 ms setTimeout in SearchBox.tsx delays the fetch until typing pauses

concepts.description: The function an effect returns runs before the next run and on unmount, which is where timers and requests from the previous run must be cancelled.
concepts.context: the effect in SearchBox.tsx returns a cleanup that clears the timer, so a newer keystroke cancels the pending one

concepts.description: Two requests in flight can finish out of order, so an older response can overwrite a newer one unless the older is cancelled or ignored.
concepts.context: controller.abort() in the cleanup stops an earlier search from landing after a later one

concepts.description: An AbortController hands a signal to fetch; aborting rejects the fetch with an AbortError that the caller must tell apart from a real failure.
concepts.context: the catch in SearchBox.tsx swallows AbortError but rethrows every other error
